items.title: 5.4 Intermolecular forces (molecules ke darmiyan forces) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.4, printed page 98.

blocks.text: Liquid ke molecules ke darmiyan intermolecular forces (molecules ke beech attraction ki forces) kaafi mazboot hoti hain. Yahan aisi teen types ki forces di gayi hain:

items: Instantaneous dipole-induced dipole forces (id-id), jinhen London dispersion forces bhi kehte hain

blocks.prompt: Teen intermolecular forces ke naam batayein. Argon, HCl aur pani ke molecules ke darmiyan in mein se kaun si forces hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: London (id-id) forces, permanent dipole-permanent dipole forces aur hydrogen bonding. Argon atoms mein sirf London forces hain. HCl mein London forces ke saath dipole-dipole forces bhi hain. Pani mein in dono ke ilawa hydrogen bonds bhi hain.

items: Liquids mein teen intermolecular forces: id-id (London), permanent dipole-permanent dipole, aur hydrogen bonding.
